left_definition: Other-user comments: number of distinct counter-arguments against the OP's view, deduplicated across comments (not comment count).
left_spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP), with title and argument as context identifying the OP's view. Count the distinct counter-arguments against the OP's view made across all comments: each separate line of argument/reason opposing the view counts once; repeated or paraphrased versions of the same argument across or within comments count once. Do not count agreement, questions, pleasantries, jokes, or moderator/bot notices. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred, even if embedded in argument or comments; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and is not itself a counter-argument unless it opposes the view. Use supplied current text; list order is not rank or chronology. Output a nonnegative integer. Empty valid list gives 0; missing or malformed OC_comments gives null; missing title/argument preventing identification of the OP's view gives null.
right_definition: Other-user comments: share of comments in the list that directly quote the original post's (title or argument) wording; endorsement or refutation not required.
right_spec: Read OC_comments (JSON list of comments by users other than the OP; parse it) together with the OP's title and argument as context for what counts as OP wording. For each comment decide whether it contains a direct quotation of wording from the OP's title or argument (verbatim or near-verbatim text, typically in quotation marks or block-quote markup, that matches available OP text). Endorsement, refutation or agreement is not required. Paraphrases without quoted wording do not count; quoting other commenters or external sources does not count. Ignore and do not count quotations of OP view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or any text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even if in argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible text. Use current supplied text; do not infer timing. Output the number of comments with a qualifying quote divided by the total number of comments in the list (range 0 to 1; 0 if none quote). If OC_comments is an empty list return null; if OC_comments, title or argument is missing/malformed such that quote matching cannot be determined return null (a positive match with available OP text may still be returned as such only if the comment share can be computed).
